rules.title: Every control works with the keyboard

act_rules.name: Scrollable content can be reached with sequential focus navigation
Iframe with interactive elements is not excluded from tab-order

rules.summary: A keyboard user must be able to reach every control the task needs with Tab and operate it with Enter, Space or the arrow keys.
fix_hints: Use a native element (button, a href, input) instead of a div or span with a click handler.
Remove tabindex="-1" from controls people need to reach.
If a custom widget must be used, give it tabindex="0", a role, and key handlers for Enter and Space.

rules.title: Focus can always leave a component

act_rules.name: Focusable element has no keyboard trap
Focusable element has no keyboard trap via standard navigation

rules.summary: Tab and Shift+Tab must always be able to move focus out of a component, such as a widget or embedded player.
fix_hints: Do not cancel Tab key events or force focus back into a component.
A modal dialog may keep focus inside while open, but Escape or a close button must release it.

rules.title: Repeated content can be skipped

act_rules.name: Document has an instrument to move focus to non-repeated content
Document has a landmark with non-repeated content
Document has heading for non-repeated content

rules.summary: When a page repeats navigation before its main content, there must be a skip link, a main landmark or headings so keyboard users do not Tab through it every time.
fix_hints: Add a "Skip to main content" link as the first focusable element, pointing at the main element's id.
Wrap the main content in a main element.

rules.title: Focus moves in a meaningful order
rules.summary: The Tab order should follow the visual reading order, so focus does not jump around the page unexpectedly.
fix_hints: Remove positive tabindex values (tabindex="1" and higher); order the DOM the way the page reads.
Avoid CSS that visually reorders controls (order, flex-direction: row-reverse, absolute positioning) away from DOM order.

rules.title: The focused control is visibly marked

act_rules.name: Element in sequential focus order has visible focus

rules.summary: When a control has keyboard focus, something on screen must change so the person can see where they are.
fix_hints: Do not remove the outline on :focus without a replacement.
Add a :focus-visible style, for example outline: 3px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px.

rules.title: The focused control is not hidden
rules.summary: A focused control must not be completely covered by sticky headers, cookie banners or other content the author added.
fix_hints: Add scroll-padding-top (equal to the sticky header height) on the html element.
Let banners be dismissed, or place them so they do not cover the page content.

rules.title: Moving focus does not change the page
rules.summary: Tabbing onto a control must not by itself open a new page, submit a form or move focus somewhere else.
fix_hints: Start navigation or submission from an explicit action such as Enter or a button press, not from a focus event.

rules.title: Controls have an accessible name

act_rules.name: Form field has non-empty accessible name

rules.summary: Every focusable control needs a name that assistive technology can announce, such as "Mark Buy milk as complete".
fix_hints: Give inputs a label element or aria-label.
Give icon-only buttons and links an aria-label or visually hidden text.

rules.title: The focus indicator is large and clear
rules.summary: The focus indicator should be at least as large as a 2 pixel outline around the control and contrast with its surroundings. Reported as advice only.
fix_hints: Use an outline of at least 2px with strong contrast against both the control and the page background.

presets.label: Essential
presets.description: Level A keyboard blockers only. Start here when adopting AccessPath.

presets.label: WCAG 2.2 AA
presets.description: The keyboard rules for WCAG 2.2 level AA, plus axe-core's A and AA page rules. The legal target most teams have.

presets.label: Strict
presets.description: WCAG 2.2 AA plus focus appearance (advisory) and axe-core best practices.
